name: jr-dictation
description: Fixes what dictation mishears ("cloud code" → Claude Code) before Claude reads your prompt, and shows each fix in your prompt row: red struck, green added.

words.title: Your corrections
words.description: Extra fixes, as heard => right, separated by semicolons. Example: acme corp => ACME; my app => MyApp

builtIn.title: Built-in corrections
builtIn.description: Use the built-in list of common developer mishears (Claude Code, TypeScript, package.json...).
